changeSet.author: opencode
changeSet.comment: Append-only log of officers confirming at the door that a household really belongs to its linked building. A confirmation only counts while the household is still linked to the same building.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE household_link_confirmation ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, request_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, household_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES household(id), hamlet_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES hamlet(id), building_id varchar(120) NOT NULL, confirmed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), officer varchar(255) NOT NULL, officer_subject varchar(255) NOT NULL, latitude double precision, longitude double precision, accuracy_m double precision CHECK (accuracy_m IS NULL OR accuracy_m >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_link_confirmation_position_pair CHECK ((latitude IS NULL) = (longitude IS NULL)), CONSTRAINT ck_link_confirmation_position_range CHECK (latitude IS NULL OR (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180)) ); CREATE INDEX ix_link_confirmation_household ON household_link_confirmation(household_id, building_id); CREATE FUNCTION household_link_confirmation_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'household_link_confirmation is an append-only log'; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER trg_household_link_confirmation_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON household_link_confirmation FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION household_link_confirmation_immutable(); COMMENT ON TABLE household_link_confirmation IS 'Append-only: officer confirmations of household-to-building links';
